title: Village market at noon
convention: Kit units, y-up, floor y=0, audience at +z looking down -z, +x = the audience's right (left/right mark names are the audience's left/right). Runtime scale: 1 unit = 1/12 of the proscenium opening width. Proscenium opening x in [-6,6], y in [0,6.75], plane z=+4. Stage floor z in [-4,4], x in [-8,8]; back wall inner face z=-4. Everything with |x|>6.85 is discarded by the runtime. Marks are [x, z].

door.note: hinge on the -x edge of the leaf; negative angle swings the free edge towards the audience (+z), positive swings it away behind the wall

meta.note: sunny set, no lamps; dressing on the back wall and sides, acting area |x|<=4.5, z -1.2..3.6 kept clear
